name: Matri
title: Ancestor of Saul's family in the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Matri is a person mentioned in 1 Samuel who belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. His family was chosen when Samuel cast lots to find Israel's first king. Saul, son of Kish, was found among Matri's clan and was anointed as Israel's first king.

keyEvents.title: Matri's family chosen by lot
keyEvents.description: When Samuel gathered the tribes of Israel to choose a king, the lot fell on the tribe of Benjamin and then on Matri's clan.

keyEvents.title: Saul found among Matri's descendants
keyEvents.description: Saul, son of Kish from Matri's clan, was found hiding among the baggage and presented as Israel's first king.

keyEvents.title: Samuel casts lots for the tribes
keyEvents.description: Samuel led the process of casting lots to identify God's chosen king, which went through the tribe of Benjamin down to Matri's clan.

keyEvents.title: Saul proclaimed king
keyEvents.description: After Saul was found among the descendants of Matri, the people shouted, "Long live the king!" and Samuel explained the rights of the kingdom.
